title: UTPro Dashboard Report: Hat-trick! Three Months in a Row of Increasing Pre-Con, Under Construction Projects in the GGH
summary:
As the World Cup takes hold of the city, new data from UTPro shows that construction and development plans for large-scale projects have both increased for the third straight month in the Greater Golden Horseshoe. 

Our UTPro Public Dashboard is provides a snapshot of development activity in the Greater Golden Horseshoe at any given time. Each month, we highlight a snippet of what's going on: the scale of planned development, what’s actively being built, and how much residential vs. non-residential space is underway.
